WITH order_averages AS (
  SELECT
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
time_in_force_averages AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.timespan,
    oa.avg_fill,
    tif.avg_fill AS timespan_avg_fill,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY oa.timespan
      ORDER BY oa.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_averages AS oa
  JOIN time_in_force_averages AS tif
    ON oa.timespan IS tif.timespan
  WHERE oa.avg_fill > tif.avg_fill
)
SELECT
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  avg_fill - timespan_avg_fill AS excess_over_timespan_avg,
  fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force figure is the average of non-NULL fillcount values across all matched execution records in that timespan; executions are equally weighted, including multiple executions from the same order.
